thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (prod-us-west) — paging SRE oncall
julia: Got the page, joining.
marie: I'm on my way, pulling logs.
derek: Observed spike in gateway timeouts and 502s. Panels show scheduler queue depth climbing rapidly.
chris: Impact: a subset of requests hitting batcher are timing out after 30s -> ~25% latency errors for customers hitting mid-sized models.
julia: What does the batching metric say? batcher_active_queue_size?
marie: `batcher_queue_size` for pool-gpu-6 -> 14k, avg batch wait 2.3s but head-of-line spikes to 20-28s.
marie: `scheduler_p99_queue_ms` up from 120ms to 29s
sre-oncall: Copy. Any deploys in last 30m?
chris: No deploys. Autoscaler shows no new nodes starting; looks like scheduler isn't routing through fallback.
julia: Reproducing logs from gateway:

```
2026-03-15T14:03:12Z gateway ERROR request_id=abcd1234 upstream=timeout status=504 route=/v1/generate
2026-03-15T14:03:18Z gateway ERROR request_id=efgh5678 upstream=502 status=502 route=/v1/generate
```

marie: Key signal: `kv-cache` mem growth on pool-gpu-6 — evictions thrashing, big prefix misses causing longer batches.
derek: Suggest immediate mitigation: pause non-critical low-priority queues to free scheduler slots and enable route-fallback to smaller-quantized model variants.
julia: +1. I'll toggle routing weight to fallback model variant (quant8-small) for prod-us-west and pause "background-embeddings" traffic.
julia: Running command:
```
redwoodctl route update --region us-west --route /v1/generate --fallback quant8-small --weight 0.25
redwoodctl queue pause --name background-embeddings --region us-west
```
chris: Done. Fallback enabled. Background queue paused.
opsbot: :white_check_mark: Routed 24% of /v1/generate to quant8-small in prod-us-west
opsbot: :white_check_mark: Paused queue background-embeddings in prod-us-west
marie: Monitoring metrics… queue depth dropping from 14k -> 3.2k in 90s. 5xx rate falling from 18% -> 6%.
julia: Nice. Any longer-term fixes? KVs thrashing indicates hot-key prefix. We should evict hot prefixes or increase kv-cache size for pool-gpu-6.
derek: We can also increase scheduler concurrency limit temporarily and enable backpressure to avoid head-of-line blocking.
sre-oncall: I'm going to cordon and restart scheduler pods in the affected node pool — rolling restart to clear stuck in-memory state. Will do one at a time.
chris: Recommend to also bump `batch_timeout_ms` down by 50% so slow KV misses don't balloon batch wait.
julia: Doing `redwoodctl config set scheduler.batch_timeout_ms=150 --region us-west` (previously 300)
julia: Applied
marie: After routing change + pause + batch_timeout change + restart of scheduler-1, 5xx -> 2.1%, p95 latency back to baseline.
opsbot: Incident annotated: incident-id=INC-20260315-01 severity=sev2
sre-oncall: Started handoff note for next oncall. Leaving in 30m for postmortem
marie: Customer impact: estimated affected API keys ~42, mostly mid-tier customers; billing impact minimal but UX degraded. CX notified.
chris: Filed quick customer notification draft in #customer-success: "We've mitigated increased timeouts for /v1/generate in US-WEST; team is investigating root cause and will follow up." @support please review
julia: Action items listed:
- Investigate hot prefix causing kv-cache thrash (marie)
- Add circuit-breaker to prevent head-of-line (derek)
- Autoscaler fix so nodes can spin up when scheduler backpressure occurs (infra)
- Postmortem + model routing playbook update (julia)
- Consider pre-warming kv-cache on pool-gpu-6 on deploy (research)

marie: I'll own the hot-prefix investigation; collecting recent keys + histogram dumps now.
chris: Thanks everyone. I'll draft postmortem starter and set follow-up meeting.
julia: Leaving handoff to @next-oncall in 15m. Good work all :tada:
sre-oncall: Handoff complete. Logged incident timeline and mitigations. Marking as mitigated but monitoring for 2h.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-20260315-01 updated: mitigated -> monitoring
marie: Quick note — found a spike in prefix `/chat-stream/v2` causing disproportionate KV misses; pushing patch to avoid cache heavy ops.
julia: Nice find. We'll include that in postmortem.
chris: Closing thread when monitoring window ends. Keep channel updated if regression.
